description: Source code implementing JSON template processing functions using cJSON library, including functions for file, memory, and stream output, as well as template application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the exploration context for JSON processing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the current JSON value with a string or number.

methods.name: sel
methods.description: Selects a JSON object or array item by name.

methods.name: subsel
methods.description: Selects a sub-item within a JSON object or array.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Enters a JSON object or array for iteration.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to the next item in iteration.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Leaves the current JSON object or array context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current JSON value as a string.
